Typically, given these considerations, one performs k-fold cross-validation using k = 5 or k = 10, as these values have been shown empirically to yield test error rate estimates that suﬀer neither from excessively high bias nor from very high variance. 5.1.5 Cross-Validation on Classiﬁcation Problems In this chapter so far, we have illustrated the use of cross-validation in the regression setting where the outcome Y is quantitative, and so have used MSE to quantify test error.
